logic.rationale: Discretionary close-based trail (playbook v1.9 §5) fired: the 11/18 regular close of 181.18 is 1.8% below the 184.5 trail. That was the third close in a three-session slide from the 191.31 high on 11/16, driven by the CMS Medicare Advantage audit proposal (UNH -10.2%, HUM -13% on 11/18). Volume was 10.4M, about twice normal, and the session low of 180.74 undercut the 11/6 hammer low. The §7 gap protocol sends close-triggered exits out in the first run after the close, whatever the hour. XLV has no extended session, so this executes at the 11/19 open. At 181.18 the lot is about +4.6% (entry 173.15) against SPY at about -5.1% over the same window. Hard stop 164.4 was never threatened.

Breakout add on XLV, closed together with tranche 1 on the same 184.5 trail that fired on the 11/18 regular close (181.18). At 181.18 it is about +1.7% (entry 178.09) against SPY at about -5.3% over the same window. Executes at the 11/19 open. Re-entry only on a new written setup under playbook §3: a fresh base and a regular close above its high, or a pullback that holds the rising ~176 50-day on a closing basis. Not in the session right after the exit.
